newsitem.title: UK: European oil swaps edge cautiously higher.
newsitem.headline: European oil swaps edge cautiously higher.

text.p: European oil swaps were broadly firmer on Tuesday with heavy fuel and gasoline ticking up $1 or so while Brent CFDs ticked up several cents on further out dates.
Gas oil crack spreads weakened with 4Q dipping to $4.25-30 from $4.40 while 1Q98 went to $4.45 and 2Q slipped to $4.05-10 from $4.10.
Brent CFDs widened out on the balance of this week between flat and +15 cents against August Brent compared with +5-8 cents on Monday. Further out dates firmed by up to five cents.
July 14-18 edged up to -14 cents against August from -19 cents while July 21-25 tracked up to -17 cents from -19 cents.
Only July 28-August 1 weakened at -21 cents from -19 cents.

Heavy fuel oil swaps were steady to $1 firmer with July talked around $85.25-85.75. Concern over just how much of a forthcoming armada of Russian fuel Mexico was expected to draw continued to hover over the market.
Some dealers were cautious of talk that the Russian material would be absorbed solely by the transatlantic draw.
Gasoline swaps were about $1 stronger with July pegged around $184.50 and August about $1 in contango.
